name: Free Online PPT (PPTX) Compressor - ATools
description: Free online PowerPoint (PPTX) compressor: Intelligently compress embedded images & media in PPTX presentations to drastically shrink file size. Pure client-side processing.
seoDescription: Free online PowerPoint (PPTX) presentation compressor. Automatically discovers and resamples large embedded images, illustrations, and background photos inside PowerPoint slides while preserving original animations, typography, and layout. Drastically reduces PPTX file size for easier sharing and email attachments. Runs 100% locally in your browser with zero file uploads.

ui.dropHint: Drop .pptx file here or click to upload.
ui.modeBalancedDesc: Optimizes embedded high-resolution illustrations while preserving clarity, repacking with maximum compression.
ui.modeAggressiveDesc: Heavier compression on embedded images, ideal for large presentations sent via email.
ui.modeRepackOnlyDesc: Repackages the ZIP container without touching any slide images.
tips: Over 85% of a PowerPoint (.pptx) file size usually comes from embedded photos and background images;
This tool unpacks locally in your browser, resampling images without altering slide animations or formatting;
All processing happens 100% client-side without uploading files to any server.
ui.errNotPptx: Please upload a PowerPoint presentation ending in .pptx
ui.errFailed: Compression failed. Please ensure the file is a valid .pptx presentation.
